title: 第十九章 黑蚁噬国 万巢祸乱 蝼蚁蚀天一劫第二十章 离火焚野 炎妖祸世 烈焰燎原一劫
content_zh:
辞白雾灵泽，别无尘雾君。四神道心历经四季轮回、人心凉薄两大终极试炼，贪嗔痴妄、得失寂灭尽数勘破，青龙生机、玄武镇御、朱雀纯阳、白虎肃杀四象神力浑然归一，道体通明无瑕，再无内惑心魔。十二重劫难已渡，西行之路仅剩最后数重灾厄，前路愈近，妖邪祸乱便愈发极端。
雾妖无心，以善护民，证得天道灵君；世间妖物万千，亦有一类，生来渺小，却以数量噬天、以阴毒祸世、以贪欲作乱，凭千万之众，蚕食山河、屠戮生灵，比凶兽巨蟒、凶煞鬼魅更为可怖。
四神离白雾谷地，西行三日，地势渐趋平坦辽阔，良田万顷、沃野千里，本是天下粮仓之地，可愈往前行，周遭景象愈发诡异。
千里沃土之上，草木根茎尽断，良田寸寸崩解，地面遍布密密麻麻的黑色蚁穴，纵横交错，深不见底；道旁村落尽数残破，屋舍地基被啃噬坍塌，墙垣千疮百孔；沿途行人绝迹，田亩荒芜死寂，空气中弥漫着腐土腥臭，无数黑色蚁尸堆积路旁，更有被啃噬殆尽的人畜骸骨，散落荒田，触目惊心。
张忠东紧握火焰灵杖，朱雀圣火微微震颤，神色凝重开口：“此地沃野千里，本该五谷丰登，如今良田崩毁、村落尽毁，皆是蝼蚁作祟所致。寻常蝼蚁，焉能有这般毁天灭地之能，定有蚁妖统领，祸乱一方。”
王学南驻足垂眸，指尖掐动卦诀，推演地脉气机，卦象凶煞滔天，阴毒缠绕，沉声道：“卦象主群凶噬主、蝼蚁蚀天。前方黑蚁山，盘踞一头千年黑蚁妖王，号玄甲蚁尊。此妖本体乃是上古玄黑毒蚁，吸纳地脉阴秽戾气修行，肉身坚硬如玄铁，剧毒蚀骨，更能统领亿万黑蚁，筑巢千里，啃噬山河、毒杀生灵、毁坏农耕，所过之处，沃土成墟、人畜无存，已将周边百里化作蚁祸死地。”
宁洋北催动青木灵气，漫布四野探查，灵气触及地面，只觉地下蚁穴绵延百里，亿万黑蚁蠢蠢欲动，无数生灵的怨毒怨气缠绕蚁巢，蚁尊潜藏地底最深主巢，妖力阴毒暴戾，以吞噬生灵精血、啃噬地脉生机壮大自身。他收敛灵气，肃然道：“蝼蚁虽微，亿万成祸。此蚁妖以数量为刃、以剧毒为攻、以巢穴为营，蚕食良田、屠戮百姓，断一方生民根本。我等西行必经此地，若不铲除蚁尊，清剿蚁患，往后此地再无生机，万千百姓流离失所。”
陈学西腰间白虎利刃寒光乍现，杀伐之气凛冽，眸光冷冽望向远方黑压压的蚁山，沉声道：“渺小之物，聚众成凶。今日便踏平蚁巢，斩杀蚁尊，荡平此祸。”
四人不再迟疑，循着遍地蚁穴踪迹，直奔黑蚁山而去。
行至半日，一座连绵起伏的低矮土山赫然出现，山体并非土石堆砌，而是亿万黑蚁筑巢而成，通体漆黑，蚁口密密麻麻，如蜂窝遍布山体；山脚下，黑色蚁群如潮水般涌动，黑压压铺天盖地，不见尽头。每一只黑蚁都比寻常蝼蚁大数倍，通体漆黑油亮，口器锋利如刃，尾刺暗藏剧毒，爬行之间，啃噬草木、腐蚀土石，凶戾无比。
尚未靠近黑蚁山，地面便剧烈震动，亿万黑蚁自地底倾巢而出，黑压压如黑云翻涌，嘶吼着朝着四神席卷而来。蚁群数量亿万，密密麻麻，遮蔽天地，所过之处，草木瞬间被啃噬殆尽，石板被啃出孔洞，人畜只需被蚁群缠上片刻，便会被啃噬成白骨，剧毒入体，神魂俱灭。
“亿万蚁群，剧毒噬人，诸位切莫被蚁群近身！”宁洋北高声提醒，青木灵气轰然爆发，青绿色生机灵光化作巨大光罩，笼罩四人身周，同时万千粗壮青藤破土而出，缠绕阻挡蚁群，生机之力化解黑蚁身上的剧毒，可蚁群数量太过庞大，青藤转瞬便被无数黑蚁啃噬断裂，前赴后继，源源不断。
陈学西身形一闪，白虎利刃应声出鞘，寒光彻骨，杀伐之气席卷全场。他身法迅捷如风，穿梭在亿万蚁潮之中，利刃每一次挥斩，便斩杀大片黑蚁，利刃锋芒扫过，黑蚁尽数碎裂，可蚁群无穷无尽，斩杀一批，又涌上一批，根本杀之不尽。
张忠东怒火中烧，朱雀纯阳圣火熊熊燃起，灵杖一挥，滔天火浪席卷四方。至阳烈火专克阴毒蚁妖，火焰所过之处，黑蚁纷纷被灼烧殆尽，发出滋滋惨叫，大片蚁群化作飞灰。可蚁群数量太过恐怖，火海虽能阻挡一时，却无法彻底清剿，蚁群绕开火海，从四面八方迂回包抄，持续围攻。
“此妖以数量制胜，单打独斗毫无用处，需先寻蚁尊主巢，斩杀首领，蚁群自会溃散！”王学南高声喝道，同时撑开玄武灵伞，厚重灵光化作坚不可摧的屏障，死死挡住四面八方涌来的黑蚁，灵伞灵光震荡，抵挡蚁群啃噬，指尖掐动地脉封印诀，封锁浅层蚁穴，阻拦更多黑蚁涌出。
四人边战边进，向着黑蚁山主巢突进。沿途黑蚁如潮水般悍不畏死，前仆后继，剧毒源源不断侵蚀灵光，四神神力持续消耗，纵然神通广大，面对亿万蝼蚁，也渐渐陷入苦战。
便在此时，黑蚁山主峰主巢洞口，传来一阵沙哑暴戾的嘶吼，声音沉闷厚重，带着无尽阴毒戾气，震得地脉颤动：“何方小辈，敢闯本座的万蚁疆土，屠戮我的子民？真是不知死活！”
嘶吼声落，一道庞大黑影自主巢中缓缓爬出。
此妖便是千年玄甲蚁尊！
蚁尊本体硕大无比，身躯如小山般庞大，通体覆盖层层叠叠的玄黑厚甲，坚硬如万年玄铁，刀枪难入；六足粗壮锋利，每一只足肢都带着剧毒倒刺，踏地便能崩裂土石；头部硕大，口器开合间寒光闪烁，獠牙锋利，能瞬间咬碎金石；尾刺粗壮，暗藏万年剧毒，一旦刺入，即刻蚀骨销魂、神魂消散；周身萦绕着浓郁的阴毒戾气，亿万黑蚁以它为尊，听其号令，妖威滔天，笼罩百里蚁域。

玄甲蚁尊居高临下，俯视着下方苦战的四神，赤红复眼凶光毕露，沙哑狂笑道：“本座统领亿万黑蚁，坐拥千里沃土，横行此地数百年，从未有人敢招惹。你们四个区区修道小辈，竟敢踏平我的蚁巢，屠戮我的子民，今日便让亿万黑蚁，将你们啃噬成一堆白骨，连神魂都不留！”
宁洋北神色凛然，厉声斥道：“你这蝼蚁孽畜，修行千年，不思安分守己，反倒统领亿万黑蚁，啃噬良田、毁坏农耕、屠戮百姓、毒杀生灵，致使百里沃土成墟，万千百姓流离失所，造下无边杀孽，天地不容！今日我等奉天命西行救世，定要踏平你的万蚁巢穴，斩杀你这蚁尊，荡平蚁患，还此地百姓一方安宁！”
玄甲蚁尊闻言，暴怒嘶吼：“天道？在本座的蚁域之中，本座便是天道！凡人修士，皆是本座子民的食粮！今日便让你们见识，亿万蝼蚁，如何噬天吞地！”
话音落下，蚁尊六足猛地一拍山体，发出号令。亿万黑蚁瞬间暴动，前赴后继，悍不畏死，疯狂围攻四神。玄甲蚁尊自身纵身一跃，庞大身躯直奔四神碾压而来，尾刺蓄力，凝聚万年剧毒，直刺宁洋北心口要害。
“妖孽休得猖狂！”张忠东见状，纵身而起，朱雀圣火汇聚极致，化作一轮烈日火轮，带着焚山煮海之威，朝着蚁尊后背狠狠砸下。
content_en:
Say goodbye to Baiwu Lingze, and say goodbye to Wuchen Wujun. The four divine Taoist hearts have gone through the two ultimate tests of the four seasons of reincarnation and the coldness of the human heart. Greed, anger, delusion, gain, loss, and death have all been explored. The four divine powers of the green dragon, Xuanwu Zhenyu, Suzaku Pure Yang, and White Tiger have been unified. The Tao body is clear and flawless, and there is no more internal confusion and demons. Twelve catastrophes have been overcome, and only the last few disasters remain on the westward journey. The closer the journey is, the more extreme the evil disasters will become.
The mist demon has no intention, protects the people with kindness, and becomes the spiritual king of heaven. There are thousands of monsters in the world, but there is one kind. They are born small, but they eat the sky with their numbers, harm the world with their poison, and cause chaos with their greed. With millions of people, they cannibalize the mountains and rivers and slaughter the living beings. They are more terrifying than the ferocious beasts, giant pythons, and evil ghosts.
Si Shen left the Baiwu Valley and traveled west for three days. The terrain gradually became flat and vast, with vast hectares of fertile fields and thousands of miles of fertile fields. It was originally the granary of the world, but the further they went, the more bizarre the surrounding scenery became.
On thousands of miles of fertile soil, the roots of vegetation have been cut off, fertile fields have disintegrated inch by inch, and the ground is covered with dense black ant nests, crisscrossing and bottomless; the villages along the road are all in ruins, the foundations of houses have been gnawed and collapsed, and the walls have collapsed. The walls are riddled with holes; there are no pedestrians along the way, the fields are deserted and lifeless, the air is filled with the stench of rotten soil, countless black ant corpses pile up on the roadside, and even the devoured human and animal skeletons are scattered in the deserted fields, which is shocking.
Zhang Zhongdong held the flaming wand tightly, the Vermilion Bird Holy Fire trembled slightly, and spoke solemnly: "This fertile land is thousands of miles away, and the harvest should have been abundant. Now the fertile fields have collapsed and the villages have been destroyed. It is all caused by ants. How can ordinary ants have the ability to destroy the heaven and earth like this? There must be an ant demon commanding them to cause trouble."
Wang Xuenan stopped and lowered his eyes, pinched the hexagrams with his fingertips, and deduced the earth's energy. The hexagrams were fierce and sinister, and he said in a deep voice: "The main hexagrams are fierce and vicious, and the ants are eating the sky. In front of the black ant mountain, there is a thousand-year-old black ant demon king, named Xuanjia Ant Lord. The demon's body is the ancient Xuanhei. Poisonous ants absorb the filthy and ferocious energy of the earth and practice it. Their bodies are as hard as black iron, and their poison corrodes bones. They can also control hundreds of millions of black ants, building nests for thousands of miles, gnawing at mountains and rivers, poisoning life, destroying farming, and turning fertile soil into ruins, leaving no one alive, and turning hundreds of miles around into a scourge of ants. "
Ning Yangbei activated the aura of green wood and spread all over the fields to explore. When the aura touched the ground, he felt that the underground ant nest stretched for hundreds of miles. Billions of black ants were ready to move. The vicious resentment of countless creatures wrapped around the ant nest. The ant master lurked in the deepest main nest underground. The demonic power was sinister and violent, devouring the essence blood of living creatures and gnawing the vitality of the earth veins to strengthen itself. He gathered his spiritual energy and said solemnly: "Although ants are small, billions of them can cause disaster. This ant monster uses its numbers as its blade, its poison as its attack, and its nest as its camp to encroach on fertile farmland, slaughter the people, and destroy the foundation of a place's livelihood. We must pass through this place on our westward journey. If we don't eradicate the ants and eliminate the ant infestation, there will be no life in this place and thousands of people will be displaced."
The white tiger's sharp blade on Chen Xuexi's waist suddenly appeared with a cold light, and he had a murderous aura. He looked at the dark ant hill in the distance with cold eyes, and said solemnly: "Small things, when gathered together, become evil. Today, we will destroy the ant nest, kill the ant master, and put an end to this disaster."
The four of them no longer hesitated, following the traces of ant nests everywhere, and headed straight for the Black Ant Mountain.
After walking for half a day, a rolling low earth mountain suddenly appeared. The mountain was not made of earth and rocks, but was made of hundreds of millions of black ants' nests. It was completely black, and the ant mouths were densely packed like honeycombs all over the mountain. At the foot of the mountain, black ant colonies surged like a tide, and the black pressure was overwhelming and there was no end in sight. Each black ant is several times larger than an ordinary ant. Its body is pitch black and shiny, its mouthparts are as sharp as a blade, and its tail sting contains highly poisonous substances. As it crawls, it gnaws away at vegetation, corrodes earth and rocks, and is extremely ferocious.
Before they even got close to the black ant mountain, the ground shook violently, and billions of black ants came out of their nests from the ground. The black mass surged like black clouds, roaring and sweeping towards the four gods. There are hundreds of millions of ant colonies, densely packed, covering the sky and the earth. Wherever they pass, the grass and trees are eaten up in an instant, holes are chewed out in the stone slabs, and humans and animals only need to be entangled by the ants.In a moment, they will be chewed into bones, poison will enter their bodies, and their souls will be destroyed.
"Billions of ant swarms are extremely poisonous, so don't let the ants get close to you!" Ning Yangbei reminded loudly, the green wood spiritual energy exploded, and the green vitality light turned into a huge light shield, covering the four people. At the same time, thousands of thick ivy sprouted out of the ground, entwining and blocking the ant colony.
Chen Xuexi's body flashed, and the white tiger blade was unsheathed with a sound. The cold light penetrated the bones, and the murderous aura swept across the entire audience. His movements were as fast as the wind, and he shuttled through the swarm of billions of ants. Every time he swung the sharp blade, he killed a large number of black ants. The sharp edge of the blade swept across, and all the black ants were shattered, but the ant colony was endless. One group was killed, and another group came up, and it was impossible to kill them all.
Zhang Zhongdong was furious, the Suzaku Pure Yang Holy Fire was blazing, and with a wave of his spiritual staff, a huge wave of fire swept across all directions. The blazing fire of Zhiyang specializes in defeating the poisonous ant monster. Wherever the flame passed, the black ants were burned to death and screamed, and large ant colonies were turned into fly ash. However, the number of ant colonies is too terrifying. Although the sea of ​​fire can block it for a while, it cannot be completely wiped out. The ants bypass the sea of ​​fire, outflank it from all directions, and continue to besiege.
"This demon wins by numbers. Fighting alone is useless. You need to find the ant master's nest first and kill the leader. The ant colony will collapse!" Wang Xuenan shouted loudly, and at the same time he opened the Xuanwu spiritual umbrella, and the thick aura turned into an indestructible barrier to block the black ants coming from all directions. The aura of the umbrella vibrated, resisting the gnawing of the ants. He pinched the Earth Veins Seal Technique with his fingertips to block the shallow ant nests and prevent more black ants from coming out.
The four of them fought while advancing towards the main nest of Black Ant Mountain. Along the way, black ants were as fierce as a tide, fearless to death, and they continued to erode the aura. The poisons continuously eroded the aura, and the four gods' powers continued to be consumed. Even though they had great magical powers, they gradually fell into a hard fight against hundreds of millions of ants.
At this moment, a hoarse and violent roar came from the main nest hole of the main peak of Black Ant Mountain. The voice was dull and thick, with endless viciousness and viciousness, which made the earth's veins tremble: "Who dares to break into my territory of ten thousand ants and slaughter my people? You really don't know whether to live or die!"
The roar fell, and a huge black shadow slowly crawled out of the nest.
This demon is the Thousand Years Mysterious Armored Ant Lord!
The Ant Lord is extremely huge, with a body as huge as a hill. The whole body is covered with layers of thick black armor, which is as hard as ten thousand years of black iron, making it difficult for guns and knives to penetrate. The six legs are thick and sharp, and each leg is equipped with poisonous barbs. It can break earth and rocks when it steps on the ground. The head is huge, and the mouthparts are cold when opening and closing. The light flashes, the fangs are sharp, and can crush gold and stone in an instant; the tail sting is thick, and it has hidden poison for thousands of years. Once it is pierced, it will instantly corrode the bones and dissipate the soul; the whole body is surrounded by a rich and sinister aura. Billions of black ants respect it and obey its orders. Its demonic power is overwhelming, covering the hundreds of miles of ant territory.
The black-armored ant was condescending, looking down at the four gods who were fighting hard below. His red compound eyes were fierce, and he laughed hoarsely and said: "I command hundreds of millions of black ants, sitting on thousands of miles of fertile soil, and have been running rampant here for hundreds of years. No one has dared to provoke me. You four mere monks dare to trample my ant nest and slaughter my people. Today, I will let billions of black ants chew you into a pile of white bones, without even leaving your soul!"
Ning Yangbei looked stern and reprimanded: "You ant evil beast, you have been cultivating for thousands of years. You don't want to keep your peace. Instead, you command hundreds of millions of black ants to gnaw fertile fields, destroy farming, slaughter people, poison and kill living creatures, causing hundreds of miles of fertile soil to become In the ruins, thousands of people have been displaced, causing endless evil, and the world will not tolerate it! Today, we are destined to go west to save the world, and we will destroy your ant nests, kill you, the ant king, eliminate the ant problem, and restore peace to the people here! "
Hearing this, the Black-armored Ant Lord roared angrily: "The way of heaven? In my ant territory, I am the way of heaven! Mortal monks are the food of my people! Today I will let you see how hundreds of millions of ants, such asWhy swallow the sky and the earth! "
After the words fell, Ant Zun's six legs suddenly slapped the mountain and issued an order. Billions of black ants instantly rioted, rushing forward one after another, fearless of death, and besieged the four gods crazily. The Black-armored Ant Lord jumped up, and his huge body went straight towards the four gods to crush him. His tail thorn charged up, condensing tens of thousands of years of poison, and stabbed directly into Ning Yangbei's heart.
"The evildoers should stop being so arrogant! "Zhang Zhongdong saw this and jumped up. The Suzaku Holy Fire gathered to the extreme and turned into a scorching sun fire wheel. With the power of burning mountains and boiling seas, it hit the Ant Lord hard on the back.
